name: tw5-github-comments
description: GitHub comments for TiddlyWiki5: comments on each tiddler, stored with giscus or utterances

paragraphs: Give your visitors a comment thread at the bottom of each tiddler, without changing the wiki itself. The comments are stored on GitHub and visitors sign in with their own GitHub account. Please add a star if you like the plugin!
Setup steps for both services are in the plugin's Setup tab.
Sibling of tw5-bluesky-comments and tw5-mastodon-comments, which show the replies to a Bluesky or Mastodon post as comments.
features: Two services: giscus (recommended) keeps the comments in GitHub Discussions, with reactions, lazy loading and translations; utterances keeps them in GitHub Issues
Each thread is found by the title [site URL] tiddler title, the same in both services, so comments never mix between wikis and threads can be moved from utterances to giscus
giscus strict title matching is on by default, so a tiddler called "Bug" never opens the thread of "Bug report"
A github-comments-term field keeps a tiddler's thread after you rename it
Upgrading from 0.0.x needs no changes (see below)
